verdict.rationale: Fellow is an AI meeting-notes product, so a training opt-out is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never mentions whether customer data is used to train AI models, and never documents an opt-out or no-training commitment. Retention policies (including zero-day retention), transcript redaction, pause-recording and admin deletion are adjacent privacy controls, not a training-use control, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
